text:
erin (AE): Quick sync — Tempest Bio wants a POC for clinical note summarization. They asked if med-summarize-v1 and the medic-v2-384q variant can run in Private (on-prem) with KMS + SSO, and what latency/throughput we see on 2x A100. Also need 3-month Dedicated POC pricing. Can @maria or @alex advise on quant/compat?

maria (SE): Short answer: med-summarize-v1 is already in our catalog and validated for Private. The medic-v2-384q variant is new to us — quant profile looks like 4-bit QAT output. Two things to check: kernel support for 4-bit ops in our runtime, and whether KV cache behavior changes with that quant.

alex (ML Eng): I ran a quick local perf test yesterday. On 2xA100 (40GB), med-summarize-v1 (fp16) -> ~85ms p95 for 512-token context with batching=4. For medic-v2-384q (4-bit), needs custom kernel; fallback path currently falls back to fp16 which increases mem but keeps latency similar.

alex (ML Eng): If we add our experimental 4bit-kernel (needs runtime patch), we can probably hit ~70ms p95 and reduce GPU mem by ~35%. But that kernel isn't enabled in Private by default.

sam (Solutions Eng): For the POC ask, customer requires KMS and SSO (Okta). Any blockers on our side for those integrations in Private?

maria (SE): KMS + Okta SSO are supported on Private. We need the customer's KMS ARN + role and their Okta metadata. Ops will need to set up a connector.

gwen (AM): Pricing question: Tempest is asking for a 3-month Dedicated POC with an expected 100k generated tokens / day. What's a ballpark?

sam (Solutions Eng): Ballpark calc: with med-summarize fp16, ~0.6ms/token GPU time at our optimized stack => roughly X GPU-hours/day. I'll throw quick numbers: 100k tokens/day ~ 60s GPU time/day if fully batched (optimistic). SLA + reserved pool premium ~monthly $Xk. (will put exact calc in doc)

erin (AE): Need exact pricing for legal and procurement. Can someone post the calc and call-out assumptions? Also they asked about model variance: can we pin model version and roll back to fp16 if 4-bit behaves worse?

alex (ML Eng): Yes — runtime supports model version pinning and automatic fallback policies. We can stage the 4-bit variant as canary and auto-fallback to fp16 on >1% regression or latency breach. Example rollout config snippet:

```
model: medic-v2-384q
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  canary_percent: 10
  rollback_on:
    regressed_quality_pct: 1
    latency_p95_ms: 200
```

maria (SE): Important security note: 4-bit QAT artifacts include custom quant tables — legal may ask for reproducibility. Sec team prefers reproducible training seeds and signed artifacts.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire received from Tempest (link: https://tempest.example/q). Please complete "Model provenance" and "Key management" sections.

erin (AE): I'll upload the questionnaire to the deal in Salesforce. Who can take the Model provenance answers?

maria (SE): I can draft it — will need input from Alex on training artifacts and from Ops on storage/keys.

sam (Solutions Eng): Ops checklist for Private POC: network egress rules, KMS key policy, Okta SAML metadata, GPU resource reservation. I can spin up the Dedicated pool once sales approves the quote.

alex (ML Eng): Quick compatibility summarize:
- med-summarize-v1: supported in Private, fp16 path validated.
- medic-v2-384q: requires enabling 4bit-kernel patch in runtime (minor change, tested internally), recommend canary first.
- KV cache: unchanged for both variants (same API), but quant changes memory; we should test long-context caching with 4-bit.

erin (AE): Action items: 1) @maria draft security/model provenance answers (due EOD Wed) 2) @alex provide artifact hashes and quant config + perf numbers (tomorrow) 3) @sam prepare Dedicated POC price calc and ops checklist (tomorrow noon) 4) I'll schedule a customer call for Thurs 10am PT.

maria (SE): ACK — I'll start the questionnaire draft.

alex (ML Eng): ACK — will attach perf logs and a sample quant config. Sample quant config:

```
quant:
  type: q4_0
  per_channel: true
  calibration: dynamic
```

sam (Solutions Eng): I'll compile pricing calc and a recommended Dedicated spec: 2xA100-40GB reserved, 2 workers, canary pool.

erin (AE): Thanks all. If we can get the sec answers and numbers before Thu call we can avoid a second meeting. :crossed_fingers:

sec-bot: Reminder — please redact any internal-only logs before sending to customer.

erin (AE): Noted. I'll set up the SFDC task and assign owners.
